name: Phoenix Shipping (Wuhan) Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: Phoenix Shipping (Wuhan) Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of dry bulk shipping, coastal, ocean integrated transport and logistics services. Its business includes dry bulk transport, shipping agents, freight forwarders, integrated logistics and special large transport, ship leasing, crew services, and property management. The company was founded on May 8, 1992 and is headquartered in Wuhan, China.
